# FlowsToken Desktop 0.7.4
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### New

- All upstream v0.5.74–v0.6.20 updates: Git import, session manager, SSH password login, workspaces, launcher (⌘T), usage stats, Dock badge, pet controls, faster large conversations.
- Element picking in the embedded browser sends an element's HTML, styles and screenshot into the composer; a local MCP server (Agent settings) lets external agents drive sessions.
- Parallel runs: fan out one task to several agents in isolated git worktrees, compare each lane's diff, and adopt the winner into your project as uncommitted changes.

### Improvements

- Agent repetition loops are stopped automatically instead of burning tokens; scheduled tasks support active hours, idle-only runs and NO_REPLY silence; optional cross-session memory (Agent settings) shares one MEMORY.md per project.

### Fixes

- Fixed tool calls stuck running after stream failures, duplicate token refreshes under concurrency, macOS window zoom reset, terminal renderer errors, Git tab anomalies, and canvas first-frame flash.

### Upgrade notes

- Double-tap modifier quick panel replaced by the Launcher (⌘T); legacy quickPanel settings ignored. Desktop pet holiday bubbles and cultivation achievement themes removed; Vivi uses default themed bubble.

## 中文

### 新增

- 上游 v0.5.74–v0.6.20 全部更新：Git 导入、会话管理、SSH 密码登录、工作空间、「启动器」（⌘T）、用量统计、Dock 角标与桌宠控制，长会话更流畅。
- 内嵌浏览器支持元素拾取，一键把元素的 HTML、样式与截图送入输入框；新增本地 MCP 服务（Agent 设置开启），外部 Agent 可驱动本客户端会话。
- 新增「并行实验」：同一任务交给多个 Agent 在独立 worktree 并行实现，对比各 lane 的 diff 后一键采纳到项目工作区。

### 改进

- 智能体重复循环自动熔断不再空耗 Token；定时任务支持运行时段、仅空闲与静默巡检；可选跨会话记忆（Agent 设置开启）让同项目会话共享一份记忆。

### 修复

- 修复流式失败时工具调用卡住、并发令牌重复刷新、macOS 窗口缩放回退、终端渲染报错、Git 页签状态异常与画布首帧错显等问题。

### 升级注意

- 双击功能键快捷面板移除并统一改用「启动器」（⌘T），旧版 quickPanel 配置忽略；桌宠节日气泡与修仙成就主题移除，Vivi 恢复默认主题气泡。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jacker2099/flowstoken-desktop/compare/v0.7.3...v0.7.4
